title: zesty golden thai rice khanom krok
description: a sweet, savory, and indulgent thai dish featuring shoyu-koji, kombu-cold-extract, and dash-friendly flavors in a delicate khanom krok.
instructions: preheat the cazuela over low heat.
soak the shoyu-koji in 100ml of hot water for at least 30 minutes.
drain and rinse the kombu, then soak it in 100ml of cold water for at least 2 hours.
cook the jasmine rice according to package instructions.
in a blender, combine the coconut milk, palm sugar, coconut oil, eggs, salt, cinnamon, ginger, and black pepper. blend until smooth.
add the blended mixture to the cooked jasmine rice and stir-fry over low heat for 5 minutes.
add the shoyu-koji mixture and kombu-cold-extract to the rice mixture and stir-fry for another 5 minutes.
stir in the soaked saffron threads and their liquid.
transfer the mixture to the preheated cazuela and cook over low heat for 15 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
use a spatula to carefully pour the mixture into 6-8 khanom krok cups.
cook the khanom krok over low heat for 10-15 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are set.
serve the khanom krok warm, garnished with toasted coconut flakes and sesame seeds if desired.
